capabilities: log gym sets inside a note
view training consistency on a dashboard
extras: The README contains only the project title, so all information comes from the manifest description; the manifest also notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record gym workouts or visualize training consistency and progress over time.
summary: Gym workout tracker that logs exercise sets inside notes and shows training consistency and progress on a dashboard.
